primitives.name: Key-point Region-Based Convolutional Neural Network for fence board detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: In the first stage, we employ a Key-point RegionBased Convolutional Neural Network (Key-point RCNN) model for fence board detection in the video frames, which is trained and fine-tuned using a manually labelled dataset.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'$$\\hat{B}$$': 'Estimated fence board bounding box in pixel coordinates', '$$V_t$$': 'Video frame at time t', '$$\\theta_{RCNN}$$': 'Learned parameters of the Key-point RCNN model'}
primitives.assumptions: Manually annotated dataset for training and fine-tuning, assuming sufficient diversity in fence board appearances.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degradation occurs when training data lacks variation in fence geometry, material, or lighting.

primitives.name: Matting Objective Decomposition Network for human occlusion segmentation
primitives.verbatim_quote: We introduce a solution in the second stage using a Matting Objective Decomposition Network (MODNet) model to handle this challenge.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'$$M_h$$': 'Binary mask indicating human regions in the frame', '$$V_t$$': 'Video frame at time t', '$$\\theta_{MODNet}$$': 'Learned parameters of the MODNet model'}
primitives.assumptions: MODNet assumes that foreground objects (humans) have smooth alpha matte boundaries.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when MODNet encounters non-human occluders or complex background textures.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state-transition logic for managing occlusion events during scene changes.
layer2.telemetry: Intersection over Union (IoU) between predicted and ground-truth masks

primitives.name: FlowNet for dynamic ad placement monitoring

primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when there are large camera movements or rapid athlete motions.

The core challenge is adversarial occlusion by humans disrupting advertised content. We formulate this as a tri-layered optimization problem: first, maximize fence board coverage while minimizing false positives; second, minimize human-mask overlap to preserve visual clarity; third, track ad consistency across frames via optical flow. The key duality lies in balancing computational efficiency against robustness to real-world variations. Failure modes include overfitting to specific stadiums and misclassifying similar structures (e.g., goal nets). To prevent leakage, we enforce cross-validation splits based on venue and broadcast angle.
